about_the_game:
The Fox and the Devil is a role-playing and strategy game in which the player takes control of Eleonora, a half-demon who has lost her mother in a war that has lasted for years. Over the course of the game, Eleonora must decide whether to embrace her demonic side and forgive the demons who killed her mother, or fight alongside the humans who demonize her race.

Gameplay: 

The Fox and the Devil is a (Hentai)turn-based RPG in which you must try to choose the best course of action to defeat the enemies, build our own statagy, explore a huge world, return old areas for new content and see how your actions change the world as you progress through the game, solve puzzles and more.


Current content:

The Fox and devil is in Early Access. At current state there is 2 out 12 Planned chapters.
There is something arround 3~4 Hours of gameplay, 870 Images in 45 Cgs.
